title: Pricing exception escalation and cost-allocation transparency procedure
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Create a standardized intake + escalation flow for enterprise pricing exceptions, marketplace credits, and commitment allocation that is auditable, minimizes manual back-and-forth, and ties decisions to a transparent cost ledger. Scope: self-serve intake form, triage rubric, approval matrix, automated thresholds, integration points with finance and billing systems.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form published in Support portal and linked from Account Exec playbook
Triage rubric implemented in Linear for PM routing with clear decision outcomes
Automated approval thresholds coded (e.g., < $5k/month auto-approve) and documented
Cost-allocation map defined and sample invoices generated for 3 customer archetypes
Audit trail available in Console for all exceptions with links to decision owner and rationale
intake_steps: Build a short intake form (Confluence + Support) capturing customer org size, ARR, commitment type, desired discount/credit, business justification, and renewal window
Initial PM review within 48 hours to categorize as standard/exception/urgent
If standard, route to Pricing Operations; if exception, create an escalation bundle (cost estimate, legal flag, SLA impact)
Request approval from pricing owners or auto-approve if below automated threshold
On approval, create billing ticket to Finance with allocation code and marketplace mapping
triage_rubric: Financial impact: estimate monthly recurring revenue impact and one-time credits
Strategic value: logo value, referenceability, competitive deflection
Compliance / Data residency constraints: require Private deployment approval
Operational burden: custom integration, special SLAs, bespoke reporting needs
Escalation tier mapping: Tier 1: auto/ops; Tier 2: pricing PM sign-off; Tier 3: Director+ and Finance
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Centralized approvals increase consistency and auditability but add latency for low-dollar requests; we will implement automated thresholds to minimize manual work
Expose ledger mappings in Console vs keep in Finance system: chose Console link + Finance canonical storage to balance transparency and single source of truth
We will support marketplace offsets as first-class allocation tags; initial rollout to EU/US regions only to limit tax/regulatory complexity
open_questions: What exact dollar thresholds should trigger manual review for EU customers given VAT complexity? (Finance input needed)
How do we represent partial month proration for commitments that start mid-cycle?
Who is final owner for marketplace credit reversals on refunds?

final_outcome_if_done: A repeatable, auditable process that reduces approval latency for small requests, ensures consistent cost-accounting for credits and commitments, and provides visibility to customers and internal stakeholders via Console and Finance ledger.
